records.jp: わたしには夢がある……。<CR>でも、お父さんの前ではちゃんとしなきゃ……
records.en_original: I have a dream... <CR>But I need to behave in front of Dad...
records.en_auxiliary: I have a dream...<CR>But I need to behave in front of Dad...
records.en: I have a dream...<CR>But I need to behave properly in front of Dad...

records.jp: けど、諦めたくない……
records.en_original: Still, I can't just give it up...
records.en_auxiliary: Still, I don't want to just give it up...
records.en: But I don't want to give it up...

records.jp: そんなにつらいなら、きちんとお父さんに言えばいいじゃない！
records.en_original: If living this double life is so painful, you should just tell him about your dream!
records.en_auxiliary: If living this double life is so painful, you should just tell him about your dream!
records.en: If it's that painful, then you should tell your father how you really feel!

records.jp: でも、そんなこと言ったらお父さんが……
records.en_original: But if I do, he'll...
records.en_auxiliary: But if I do, he'll...
records.en: But if I do, Dad will...

records.jp: ずっと一緒にいる家族なんだから、本音で向き合わないと。<CR>亜子がどう思っているか、何を悩んでいるか！
records.en_original: He's family. You have to be able to speak openly with him. Tell him what you're thinking, what you're worried about!
records.en_auxiliary: He's family. You have to be able to speak openly with him. Tell him what you're thinking, what you're worried about!
records.en: He's family, and you'll be together for a long time, so you have to face him honestly.<CR>Tell him what you think and what you're struggling with!

records.jp: いい子のふりしたって、どこかで行き詰まるだけだよ
records.en_original: Even if you try to put up a front and be a good daughter, the truth will catch up to you somewhere down the road.
records.en_auxiliary: Even if you try to put up a front and be a good daughter, the truth will catch up to you somewhere down the road.
records.en: Pretending to be a good girl will only leave you stuck sooner or later.

records.jp: それに、まだお父さんと話もしてないんでしょ？<CR>話してみないと本当のところはわかんないよ
records.en_original: Besides, you haven't even talked to your dad yet, right? You never know how he'll react until you speak up.
records.en_auxiliary: Besides, you haven't even talked to your dad yet, right? You never know how he'll react until you speak up.
records.en: Besides, you haven't even talked to your father yet, have you?<CR>You won't know how he really feels unless you talk to him.

records.jp: 私だって……いろいろと誤解してた部分はあったし
records.en_original: I know... I've made plenty of wrong assumptions.
records.en_auxiliary: I've made plenty of wrong assumptions myself.
records.en: I misunderstood a lot of things, too...

records.jp: ……そっか。そうだね
records.en_original: ...Yeah. Yeah, you're right!
records.en_auxiliary: ...Yeah. Yeah, you're right!
records.en: ...I see. You're right.

records.jp: あっ、フラグメント……！
records.en_original: Her Fragment...!
records.en_auxiliary: Her Fragment...!
records.en: Her Fragment...!

records.jp: 無事に回復したから出てきたみたい
records.en_original: Looks like it emerged because she was able to heal safely.
records.en_auxiliary: Looks like it emerged because she was able to heal safely.
records.en: Looks like it appeared now that it has recovered.

records.jp: ヒナちゃん、急いで固定化して！
records.en_original: Now, Hina! Stabilize it!
records.en_auxiliary: Now, Hina! Stabilize it!
records.en: Now, Hina-chan! Stabilize it!

records.jp: うん！
records.en_original: Right!
records.en_auxiliary: Right!
records.en: Yeah!

records.jp: 指輪だ……！
records.en_original: A ring...!
records.en_auxiliary: A ring...!
records.en: A ring...!

records.jp: あっちゃんがヒナちゃんに心を開いてくれた証だね！
records.en_original: It's proof that Akky opened her heart to you, Hina!
records.en_auxiliary: It's proof that Akky opened her heart to you, Hina!
records.en: It's proof that Acchan opened her heart to you, Hina-chan!

records.jp: また一人、仲間が増えたね
records.en_original: You've gained another friend.
records.en_auxiliary: We've gained another friend.
records.en: We've got another friend now.

records.jp: あれ、わたしいつの間に学校に……。<CR>白井ちゃん。それに司城さんたちも……
records.en_original: Hey, since when have I been at school...? Wait, Shirai? Wjat are you doing here? And BOTH of the Shijous?
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, since when have I been at school...? Wait, Shirai? What are you doing here? And BOTH of the Shijous?
records.en: Huh? When did I get back to school...?<CR>Shirai-chan... and Shijou-san and the others too...

records.jp: その指輪は……？
records.en_original: And what's with this ring?
records.en_auxiliary: And what's with the ring?
records.en: That ring...?

records.jp: それは亜子ちゃんの指輪だよ
records.en_original: It's yours, Ako.
records.en_auxiliary: It's yours, Ako.
records.en: It's yours, Ako-chan.

records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: いいからつけてみて！
records.en_original: Here, I'll help you try it on!
records.en_auxiliary: Here, I'll help you try it on!
records.en: Just try putting it on!

records.jp: わっ、ちょっと！
records.en_original: W-Wait, hey!
records.en_auxiliary: W-wait, hey!
records.en: W-Wait, hey!

records.jp: なんか……記憶が流れ込んでくる
records.en_original: All these...memories are flowing into my head...
records.en_auxiliary: All these...memories are flowing into my head...
records.en: All these...memories are flowing into my head...

records.jp: えっ？
records.en_original: What's going on?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: 言ったでしょ？　指輪はリフレクターと力を共有するって。<CR>それはつまり、フラグメントの記憶も統合されるってことだよ
records.en_original: It's like I said. Rings connect people to Reflectors. They just happens to share a few memories in the process.
records.en_auxiliary: It's like I said. Rings connect people to Reflectors. They just happen to share a few memories in the process.
records.en: I told you, remember? The rings let their wearers share a Reflector's power.<CR>That means the Fragment's memories are integrated as well.

records.jp: あくまでフラグメントの記憶だから、一部分だけだけどね
records.en_original: Only the memories pertaining to the wearer's Fragment, of course, but still.
records.en_auxiliary: Only the memories pertaining to the wearer's Fragment, of course, but still.
records.en: They're only the Fragment's memories, so you only get part of them.

records.jp: 共有されるって……ま、まさか……！
records.en_original: If our memories are shared... D-does that mean...!?
records.en_auxiliary: If our memories are shared... D-does that mean...!?
records.en: If our memories are shared... D-does that mean...!?

records.jp: あーっ！　白井ちゃん、やっぱり魔法少女だったんじゃん！
records.en_original: I KNEW IT! You really were a magical girl after all!
records.en_auxiliary: I KNEW IT! You really were a magical girl after all!
records.en: I knew it! Shirai-chan, you really are a magical girl!

records.jp: （やっぱり！　こ、このままじゃ記事にされちゃう）
records.en_original: (That's what I was afraid of. Now she's going to write an article about me and everything...)
records.en_auxiliary: (That's what I was afraid of! Now she's going to write an article about me and everything...)
records.en: (I knew it! A-At this rate, she'll write an article about me.)

records.jp: えっと、亜子。そのことなんだけど……
records.en_original: Um, Ako? About that...
records.en_auxiliary: Um, Ako! About that...
records.en: Um, Ako? About that...

records.jp: 大丈夫！　記事にはしないよ！
records.en_original: Not to worry! Your secret's safe with me.
records.en_auxiliary: Not to worry! Your secret's safe with me.
records.en: It's okay! I won't write an article about it!

records.jp: ……本当？
records.en_original: ...Really?
records.en_auxiliary: ...Really?
records.en: ...Really?

records.jp: だって、白井ちゃんには助けてもらったし、友達だからね。<CR>秘密にしておくよ！
records.en_original: Of course! You saved me, so I'll keep it a secret! That's what friends do, after all.
records.en_auxiliary: Of course! You saved me, so I'll keep it a secret! That's what friends do, after all.
records.en: You saved me, Shirai-chan, and we're friends.<CR>I'll keep it a secret!

records.jp: ありがとう……
records.en_original: Thanks...
records.en_auxiliary: Thanks...
records.en: Thanks...

records.jp: けど魔法少女なんて本当にいるんだねー
records.en_original: But wow. Magical girls really exist, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: But wow. Magical girls really exist, huh?
records.en: But wow. Magical girls really exist, huh?

records.jp: そんなファンタジーな存在がいるなら、わたしがジャーナリストに<CR>なるくらい全然普通だし、お父さんも説得できそうだよね！
records.en_original: Compared to all this hocus-pocus, journalism seems totally sane now. I'm sure I'll be able to convince my dad!
records.en_auxiliary: Compared to all this hocus-pocus, journalism seems totally sane now. I'm sure I'll be able to convince my dad!
records.en: If fantastical beings like magical girls really exist,<CR>then becoming a journalist is totally normal! I should be able to convince Dad!

records.jp: ジャーナリストになるのが“夢”だったんだ？
records.en_original: That's your dream? To be a journalist?
records.en_auxiliary: That's your dream? To be a journalist?
records.en: That's your dream? To be a journalist?

records.jp: （別に反対されるような職業でもないと思うけど）
records.en_original: (THAT's what she was worried he'd disapprove of? Really?)
records.en_auxiliary: (That's what she was worried he'd disapprove of? Really?)
records.en: (I don't think that's the kind of career someone would normally oppose.)

records.jp: うん！　フリーの記者になって特ダネをばんばん取っていくの！<CR>紛争地帯とかにも飛びこんで社会の矛盾を暴いていくつもり！
records.en_original: Yup! Just call me Scoops, because I'm gonna be a reporter! Going into warzones and exposing society's contradictions!
records.en_auxiliary: Yup! Just call me Scoops, because I'm gonna be a reporter! Going into war zones and exposing society's contradictions!
records.en: Yeah! I'm going to become a freelance journalist and land scoop after scoop!<CR>I'll even jump into conflict zones and expose society's contradictions!

records.jp: （それは普通に反対されるよ……）
records.en_original: (Okay, thaaaaat he'd probably disapprove of.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Okay, thaaaaat he'd probably disapprove of.)
records.en: (He'd have perfectly normal reasons to oppose that...)

records.jp: そういえば、亜子のお父さんって厳しそうな人だったよね。<CR>結構お堅い仕事してるの？
records.en_original: By the way, Ako, your dad seemed pretty strict. Is he a higher-up at some big, serious business or something?
records.en_auxiliary: By the way, Ako, your dad seemed pretty strict. Is he a higher-up at some big, serious business or something?
records.en: Come to think of it, Ako, your father seemed pretty strict.<CR>Does he work in some really conservative field?

records.jp: うーん、別に仕事自体は堅くないかなぁ。<CR>いろいろ上下関係とかは厳しいみたいだけど
records.en_original: Hmm, I wouldn't say his work itself is serious. It does sound like it can get pretty political, though.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm, I wouldn't say his work itself is serious. It does sound like the hierarchy can be pretty intense, though.
records.en: Hmm, his work itself isn't particularly conservative.<CR>Apparently the hierarchy and things like that are pretty strict, though.

records.jp: えっと、この人だよ！
records.en_original: I should have a picture...here we go!
records.en_auxiliary: I should have a picture...here we go!
records.en: Um, this is him!

records.jp: ？　これって昨日ニュースになってた大物歌手の……って、え？
records.en_original: Huh? Isn't this the famous singer that was on the news yesterday? ...NO. WAY.
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Isn't this the famous singer that was on the news yesterday? ...NO. WAY.
records.en: Huh? Isn't this the famous singer who was in the news yesterday...? Wait, what?

records.jp: うん。わたしのお父さん。歌手なんだ
records.en_original: Yeah. That's my dad. He's a singer.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. That's my dad. He's a singer.
records.en: Yeah. He's my dad. He's a singer.

records.jp: えええーーーー！？
records.en_original: WHAAAAAAT!?
records.en_auxiliary: WHAAAAAAT?!
records.en: WHAAAAAAT!?
